# mvmctl

> mvmctl manages Firecracker microVMs on Linux with KVM. The public 0.3 documentation covers a prerelease and environment blueprint schema version `"1"`.

## Complete reference

- [Full command and environment reference](https://mvmctl.aland20.com/llm.txt): Operator guidance, CLI commands, configuration, environment blueprint directives, and examples.
- [Versioned 0.3 reference](https://mvmctl.aland20.com/docs/0.3/llm.txt): The 0.3 edition of the full reference.
- [SHA-256 checksum](https://mvmctl.aland20.com/docs/0.3/llm.txt.sha256): Integrity check for the 0.3 edition.
